'''Blue Wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] that served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] and flew [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. In [[3951 BBY]], Blue Wing was one of two Aurek units instrumental in bringing the [[Old Sith Wars]] to an end. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Carth Onasi]], the wing participated in the [[Battle of Telos IV]] where it fought against the [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith]] forces of [[Darth Nihilus]].
